content: Web Push relay pitfalls: treat HTTP 410 Gone as terminal—delete subscription immediately, never retry. Handle pushsubscriptionchange in SW to sync new endpoint before 410. VAPID JWT clock skew causes 401. Payload max ~4KB—send habit id/deep link only. Subscription endpoint is per-device anonymous token (no accounts needed) but relay must store endpoint+p256dh+auth+timezone+reminder prefs. Clean expired subs to protect delivery reputation.
